Title: Heirs to the Blood booster box

Messages.Author: atomweaver
Messages.Body:
Hi,

"Rescued" a sealed box of Heirs to the Blood boosters from a lightly-travelled gaming store. I've got plenty of this set, but thought it would be of interest to someone here.

$215 plus shipping to the first interested party that contacts me by PM here.

I will ship either US domestic or international, using US Post Office Priority Flat Rate Medium Box to ship. You can estimate shipping to your destination at postcalc.usps.com/ with the "ship from" zip code 06790 (USA). If you want this via a different shipping method, please ask and we can likely work something out.

Payment accepted via paypal, money order, or personal check (I will wait for a personal check to clear before shipping).

Thanks!

EDIT - Ebay Trend for HttB boosters is downwards. Price modified downwards to 10% below the one month rolling average.

Messages.Author: yesferatu

It's a collectable set, which is both great and out of print, from a company that doesn't exist anymore. If you can get it cheaper somewhere else, buy it.

I have sold a few - people are buying them at my listed price.

Really, if someone wants the box...they'll probably pay for it.
They're pretty hard to find. I wouldn't expect people to be giving these away.
It's not like anyone is selling a ton of these or Keepers.

Good luck, Atomweaver! Excellent find.
